name: meal-journal
description: Offline-first PWA in React and TypeScript for logging eating patterns, built to learn data sync between devices

paragraphs: 🚀 Live app: meal-journal-dxl.pages.dev — open it on your phone and add it to your home screen.

An offline-first PWA for logging eating patterns — a photo of the meal, the reason you reached for food, and how you felt about it. It doesn't count calories — it shows patterns over time: when you eat out of boredom, when you eat your stress, and when it's simply hunger. It lets you see your own food decisions in a broader perspective.

I'm building this project mainly for myself and my own personal growth, not to get a finished app as quickly as possible. That's why I deliberately limit what I use AI for here — which doesn't mean I don't use it at all, only that the goal is different from "ship the product as fast as possible".
features: Log a meal with a photo, a reason ("trigger") and your own rating of the choice
Day view with a date picker
Month summary: a day-by-day "satisfaction" heatmap of your decisions + a chart of the most common triggers
Fully offline: photos and metadata live locally on the user's device
